results.content:
CapCut reviews show overwhelming complaints about non-existent customer support, impossible subscription cancellations, and billing errors. Users often report being charged unwillingly or struggling to resolve issues with real people.

What common limitations or technical issues are pointed out in CapCut reviews?

CapCut reviews often mention a 15-minute video limit, which restricts long-form content creation. Additionally, users note the limitation of a single video/audio track for complex edits and report that the desktop app can be buggier than the mobile version.

Are there privacy concerns often brought up in CapCut reviews due to CapCut's connection to ByteDance? [...] Impossible Cancellations: Countless users say they can't figure out how to cancel their Pro subscription, leading to monthly charges they don't want.
 Billing Errors: People report being charged during their free trial, getting billed twice, or seeing charges continue even after they managed to cancel.
 Non-Existent Support: The number one complaint is the total lack of help from a real person. Users say their emails get answered by bots with useless, canned responses or are just flat-out ignored. Good luck getting a receipt, fixing a billing problem, or talking to a human.

An image of the negative CapCut reviews on Trustpilot, highlighting customer support and billing complaints. [...] An image of the negative CapCut reviews on Trustpilot, highlighting customer support and billing complaints.

I have tried contacting human support multiple times, and they [...] I am currently facing what appears to be an attempt to charge me twice for a subscription, and resolving the issue has been unnecessarily difficult. CapCut makes it confusing to understand which account or subscription is connected to which email, especially when using different devices or trying to connect existing desktop projects to the correct account.

What makes the situation even more frustrating is the lack of accessible customer support. Finding a proper help center or a straightforward way to contact someone and resolve a billing issue is incredibly difficult.

For a company that charges users for subscriptions and stores their projects in its ecosystem, account and subscription management should be simple and transparent.
